geometry_pose: Zero projected current/history RGB-text products and native appearance scores; keep static geometry-language context, static logits, pose distance and common visibility/ROI quality metadata.
rgb_text: Zero geometric-language candidate context, static logits/probability and explicit pose distance; retain RGB/text and common visibility/quality metadata.
current_rgb: Disable history consistently including features, validity, quality and native fusion.
limitation: These are residual descriptor subsets on the SAME frozen geometric base and common observation support. Not strict map-free or sensor-free complete-system baselines.
selection: No training/model selection or threshold tuning; established checkpoint and thresholds fixed before new held-out inference
